_help: One entry per pair number (NN = the number in the file names). Keys starting with _ are ignored. Only the fields you fill in are used; the rest get defaults (category photo, difficulty 2, 1 try).

_example.subject: a bowl of ramen on a wooden table
_example.tell: Look at the chopsticks and the rim of the bowl: AI often melts details there.

01.subject: a snowy courtyard seen from above, with giant chess pieces
01.tell: Look at the giant chess pieces and the footprints: AI often merges the pieces together and scatters the footprints at random.
01.prompt: A candid photo taken from a high apartment window of a snowy courtyard during snowfall: two snow-covered pine trees, a picnic table and a ping-pong table, a row of giant white chess pieces standing on the snow and many footprints crossing the courtyard. Overcast light, slightly desaturated, taken with a phone. Square format.

02.subject: penne with meatballs in a white bowl, flash photo
02.tell: Count the penne tubes: AI often fuses them or leaves them without a hole, and the sauce looks too evenly spread.
02.prompt: A close-up photo taken with a phone flash of penne pasta with meatballs and caramelized onions in tomato sauce, in a white bowl on a white table. Slightly harsh flash lighting, amateur snapshot, a bit greasy and unstyled. Square format.

03.subject: a person seen from behind on a stone pier looking at the sea
03.tell: Check the long stone slabs and the feet: AI bends the slab lines and often gets shoes or proportions wrong.
03.prompt: A candid photo of a young man seen from behind, wearing a dark navy puffer jacket and dark jeans with white sneakers, standing on a wide old stone pier and looking out at a calm grey sea under an overcast sky. Wide-angle phone camera, natural light, slightly tilted. Square format.

04.subject: brownies on baking paper, close-up
04.tell: The cracks of the brownie look too regular and the baking paper folds don't quite make physical sense.
04.prompt: A close-up phone photo of homemade brownies with a cracked shiny top, in a baking tin lined with crinkled parchment paper on a wooden board. Warm indoor light, slightly blurry edges, amateur snapshot. Square format.

05.subject: a grassy hillside with two walkers and tiny hikers on the ridge
05.tell: Zoom on the tiny hikers on the ridge: AI turns them into blobs with odd limbs, and the path on the slope doesn't lead anywhere.
05.prompt: A phone photo of a green grassy hillside leading up to a rocky ridge under a blue sky with soft clouds. Two people walk away from the camera in the foreground, wearing dark jackets and jeans, and a few tiny hikers are visible along the ridge in the distance. Natural light, slightly wide-angle. Square format.

06.subject: a thin-crust pizza on a blue tablecloth
06.tell: Look at the tablecloth pattern and the slice cuts: AI repeats the pattern oddly and the cuts don't line up.
06.prompt: A casual phone photo of a thin-crust pizza with melted cheese and minced meat sauce, already cut into slices with some slices pulled apart, on a light blue plate over a blue patterned tablecloth, with a drinking glass at the top edge. Indoor light, a bit overexposed, amateur snapshot. Square format.

07.subject: slanted rock slabs on a summit with hazy hills
07.tell: The rock layers should follow one direction and the haze should fade evenly: AI often changes the angle of the slabs and over-sharpens the distance.
07.prompt: A phone photo from a mountain summit of slanted grey rock slabs covered with dry golden grass in the foreground, with layers of hazy blue hills and valleys stretching to the horizon. Clear day, slightly wide-angle lens, natural colors, no people. Square format.

08.subject: a wet path covered in autumn leaves
08.tell: The fallen leaves repeat the same shapes and the ivy on the trunks looks pasted on instead of growing around them.
08.prompt: A phone photo of a wet asphalt path winding through an autumn park, covered in fallen yellow and brown leaves, with ivy-covered tree trunks and thick bushes on both sides. Overcast, damp light, slightly blurry from walking, natural colors, no people. Square format.

09.subject: ducks swimming on an autumn pond
09.tell: Count the ducks and look at their wakes: AI merges ducks together, and the reflections don't match the trees.
09.prompt: A phone photo of a calm brown pond in autumn, with four mallard ducks swimming in a line in the middle distance, reflections of trees in the water, and bright green grass with a few fallen leaves in the foreground. Natural light, slightly crooked framing, casual snapshot. Square format.

10.subject: a stone-paved path through a green forest
10.tell: The paving stones: AI makes them too even or melts them into each other, and the drainage channel changes width.
10.prompt: A phone photo of a narrow path paved with irregular flat stones going up through a dense green forest, sunlight filtering through the leaves, a small drainage channel along the right edge. Summer day, slightly wide-angle, natural colors, no people. Square format.

11.subject: a natural limestone rock arch against a blue sky
11.tell: The rock arch: AI often makes the rock layers run in impossible directions, and the trees on top look pasted on.
11.prompt: A phone photo looking up at a huge natural limestone rock arch against a deep blue sky, with a few small trees growing on top and a pale stony path with patches of green grass leading underneath. Strong sun, wide-angle lens, slightly distorted perspective, natural colors, no people. Square format.

12.subject: a deep misty mountain gorge
12.tell: The mist is too even and the cliff walls repeat the same texture; real gorges have irregular light and ledges.
12.prompt: A phone photo from a high viewpoint down into a very deep, narrow mountain gorge with steep grey limestone walls and green vegetation on the right slope, a thin hazy mist and soft sunbeams in the middle of the valley, a tiny river barely visible at the bottom. Hazy morning light, no people. Square format.

13.subject: a goat with curved horns on rough rock
13.tell: Check the horns, legs and hooves: AI makes the horns too symmetrical and may merge a hoof into the rock or add a leg.
13.prompt: A close phone photo of a white and dark-brown goat with curved horns and a short beard standing on rough grey rock and looking straight at the camera, grass and a rock wall behind it. Wide-angle lens, shot from slightly above, daylight, casual snapshot. Square format.

14.subject: stone figures on a foggy coast with distant islands
14.tell: The four stone figures: AI makes them too clear and too similar to each other, and the distant islands are too crisp for the haze.
14.prompt: A phone photo on a cloudy foggy day of a barren brown and sandy coastal plateau, with four small rough carved stone figures standing in a row in the foreground, a flat grey sea and two distant rocky islands in the haze. Flat grey light, muted colors, no people. Square format.

15.subject: a green volcanic lagoon with a warning sign
15.tell: Read the warning sign: AI writes gibberish on signs and draws the pictogram wrong.
15.prompt: A phone photo of a bright yellow-green lagoon beside a black sand beach at the foot of a crumbling volcanic crater wall with layered ash stripes, a red gravel slope in the foreground with a small red and white prohibition sign on a wooden post. Blue sky with a few small clouds, sunny day, no people. Square format.

16.subject: a praying mantis on a white wall
16.tell: Count the legs and the joints: AI invents extra segments, and the shadow on the wall doesn't match the insect.
16.prompt: A close-up phone photo of a green praying mantis climbing vertically on a white painted wall next to a dark metal pipe, with long thin antennae and a clear shadow on the wall. Indoor evening light with a bit of flash, slightly out of focus at the edges. Square format.

17.subject: an open palm with a bruise (optional: it is a body close-up)
17.tell: Fingers and palm lines: AI draws too many creases or uneven finger lengths, and the bruise fades too smoothly.
17.prompt: A close-up phone photo of an open hand held toward the camera, palm up, with a large purple-grey bruise on the palm, visible skin creases and a few hairs on the wrist, in a kitchen with a light wooden floor and a blue-lidded plastic food container on a table in the background. Indoor light, casual snapshot. Square format.

18.subject: a teenager in a red jersey picking up scattered pasta from a kitchen floor
18.tell: The pasta scattered on the floor and the hands and feet: AI scatters pieces too evenly or merges them, and tangles the limbs.
18.prompt: A top-down phone photo of a teenager in a red football jersey and white clogs crouching on a light wooden kitchen floor, head bowed, picking up dry pasta pieces scattered on the floor and putting them into a clear plastic bowl; white kitchen cabinets behind. Indoor light, casual snapshot, face not visible. Square format.

19.subject: a castle on a hill seen through a car window
19.tell: The castle walls turn into a blur of towers, and the power line and glass reflections tend to disappear.
19.prompt: A phone photo taken through a car window of a steep forested hill with a ruined medieval castle on top, blue sky with a few white clouds, dry golden grass and bushes in the foreground, a power line crossing the lower left and faint reflections on the glass. Sunny day, casual snapshot. Square format.

20.subject: a green natural pool under limestone cliffs with swimmers
20.tell: The tiny swimmers: AI draws them with odd bodies, and the green of the water is too uniform.
20.prompt: A phone photo of a natural bright green pool at the foot of tall grey and ochre limestone cliffs with a small waterfall in the back, pink oleander flowers in the right foreground and a few tiny people swimming far away. Partly cloudy sky, summer day, slightly wide-angle. Square format.
